routes.title: 1. アルクェイド / Arcueid + Dead Ends 01–11
routes.notes: NEW GAME, save before the first choice, then KANNAGI's Arcueid path. Independent optional variants from XNEO are retained as evidence, not concatenated into a single path. Asobigokoro local saves 1–10 map to global saves 2–11.

routes.title: 2. シエル Normal / 夜の虹 + Dead Ends 12–19
routes.notes: Load global Save 1 or start NEW GAME after Arcueid clear. Use the Ciel-specific early choices. Follow KANNAGI's Day 4 refusal/leave/return/glasses choices and Day 8 Arcueid preference, preparing the documented path for Extra, not every high-affection scene. Dead End 15 is fully expanded through Day 11 before loading global Save 14 on Day 9. Dead End 14 now uses KANNAGI's EARLIER conversation-delay entrance immediately after Save 15, then reloads and performs the good conversation once. Asobigokoro local saves 3–11 map to global saves 12–20; its local 1–2 duplicate already-collected common dead ends.

routes.title: 3. シエル Extra / 白日の碧 + Dead Ends 20–21
routes.notes: Load global Save 20 only AFTER clearing Normal. The save retains the affection state from the exact preceding playthrough. Asobigokoro local saves 12–13 map to global saves 21–22. Final Ciel lesson is described in the terminal English hint, not added as an invented OCR choice.

source_policy.set_A: KANNAGI common, heroine, and bad-end pages.
source_policy.set_B: XNEO for choices by default; Asobigokoro for save annotations, ending labels, and the individually documented supplemental choices.
source_policy.field_semantics: jpGuide1/jpGuide2 preserve the source wording, including differing optional choices. They are evidence, not two instructions to execute. simpleJp is the selected path. Missing-source fields use the upstream canonical placeholders.

Ciel Day 13 琥珀を追い返す。 (also in XNEO)
Dead End 15 silent response 『……(いや、下手な言葉は逆効果だ)』

disagreements: KANNAGI and XNEO choose different optional Day 1/2 scenes on Arcueid. The guide follows one continuous KANNAGI path, rather than splicing choice variants.
Japanese guides give multiple optional number guesses and Day 11 Arcueid responses. This guide selects one documented option, not every scene.

Japanese sources differ on パンを買って/買ってきて, もう少し/もうすこし, 俺が/俺の, glasses-choice prefixes, quotation marks, and ellipsis/dash lengths. Source spellings are retained in evidence fields. Exact on-screen text still needs in-game confirmation.
NookGaming uses different optional Ciel Day 2/6/12 scenes and the other valid final-warning response on Extra. This guide follows the Japanese path.
KANNAGI omits 琥珀を追い返す。; XNEO and Asobigokoro both document it, so it is included.

Dead End 15: KANNAGI supplies a complete Day 9–11 sequence. Asobigokoro documents an extended alternative, including 因果応報, はっきりと言い返す, greeting everyone, the curry response, and a later Noel question. The guide keeps KANNAGI's continuous chain and Asobigokoro's documented checkpoint, without combining alternative state/choice chains. Both sets document the silent response with differing typography; both quotations are now present.

Dead End 14: KANNAGI documents two entrances. This guide now uses the earlier 問題はない。話は放課後にすればいいし。 entrance at Asobigokoro's source-backed conversation checkpoint. After the terminal it loads Save 15 and performs the good conversation once; removing the marked detour also leaves the conversation once.
KANNAGI's bad-end HTML accidentally duplicates id=bad-end-15 for Dead Ends 14 and 15. Labels/content, not those anchors, identify the branches.
Follow-up: XNEO, Game × First Impression, and Ponkotu Gamer independently print 俺の起こした現実だ on Day 3; simpleJp now uses の rather than KANNAGI's が. Original Set A/B quotations remain unchanged.

Follow-up: Ponkotu Gamer distinguishes Extra entry from additional late high-affection flowchart scenes. Its warning that refusing cooperation lowers affection means the old hint that this refusal preserves affection was misleading and has been corrected. The documented KANNAGI/XNEO/NookGaming route still uses that refusal; no claim is made that it fills every high-affection variant.
Follow-up: Ponkotu Gamer independently confirms the Day 9 painful/ineffective medicine forces Dead End 15 on Day 11; the expanded detour is retained.

The owner requested changes because the original 2021 Japanese walkthroughs did not prove 2024 menu/state equivalence. The caller has now explicitly authorized retargeting to the 2021 Japanese Switch Download Edition (r82483). No equivalence with 2024 is asserted, and no source exception or review approval is implied.

Current target scope: KANNAGI and XNEO document the original 2021-08-26 PS4/Switch remake, rather than the 2024 multilingual edition. The target is now the original Japanese Switch download release. Source differences in literal choices remain unresolved and must be reconciled for this target. Normal-clear/Save20-to-True behavior must be independently rechecked against the original-release source sets; an old structural PASS does not satisfy the retargeted accuracy gate.
